filing_office: New Mexico Secretary of State, Business Services Division
filing_fee_notes: The SOS directs applicants to the fee displayed on the online form. The accessible official material did not confirm the current LLC formation amount.
state_tax_registration_agency: New Mexico Taxation and Revenue Department
unemployment_insurance_agency: New Mexico Department of Workforce Solutions
plain_english_summary: Submit the LLC formation application through the Secretary of State's online portal. Register separately for applicable state taxes.
common_mistake: Do not send a paper business application; the SOS requires online filing.
notes: Scope: ordinary domestic LLC. The forms portal blocked direct retrieval; its official indexed text confirms the document name. The SOS-linked filing guide requires a Registered Agent Statement of Acceptance, but detailed agent eligibility rules were not confirmed. Current formation and reservation fees, standard processing time, expedite options, LLC periodic-report requirement and all report fields, franchise or privilege tax treatment, publication requirements and operating-agreement mandate remain null. The vendor-hosted guide is an official SOS publication linked from its User Guides page.
